title: Paladins, Priests, Rogues & Warriors
subtitle: The RPG Series classes: a weapon, a class book, its armor

quests.title: Spell Binding Table
description: The Spell Binding Table is where you take up a class: Paladin, Priest, Rogue or Warrior.
Craft one from a book, a gold ingot, amethyst shards and polished diorite, and set bookshelves around it, as you would an enchanting table.
Use it to create your class's spell book (one level), then bind the class's spells into that book for levels and lapis lazuli.

quests.title: Spell Scrolls
description: Spell Scrolls turn up in dungeon, temple, pyramid, outpost and stronghold chests (they aren't Iron's Spells scrolls).
Each holds one spell, which the Spell Binding Table can add to your spell book.

quests.title: The Monk
description: Some villages have a Sanctuary, home of the Monk: a villager who sells Paladin and Priest gear.
A villager without a job becomes a Monk at a Monk Workbench, which you can also craft. Buy something from one.

quests.title: The Arms Dealer
description: Some villages have Barracks, home of the Arms Dealer, the Rogues & Warriors villager.
A villager without a job becomes an Arms Dealer at an Arms Station, which you can also craft. Trade with one.

quests.title: A Paladin's Mace
description: Paladins wear heavy armor and fight with maces, great hammers and kite shields, healing and shielding their friends as they go.
Craft an Iron Mace (JEI shows the recipe). Its spell, Smash, comes with it: hold the mace and press use (right-click) to cast. Great hammers carry Ground Slam.
The spell bar on your screen shows what you can cast.

quests.title: Paladin Libram
description: At the Spell Binding Table, create a Paladin Libram and bind your first Paladin spell into it.
Equip the libram in its spell book slot and hold a weapon: its spells join your weapon's on the spell bar. Cast one.
It suits heavy weapons best, with a shield for a more defensive style.

quests.title: Paladin Armor
description: Paladin armor is heavy plate that also adds healing power. Craft it (JEI shows the recipe) or buy it from a Monk.
Crusader armor comes next, made with gold and ghast tears, and then its netherite version at the smithing table.

quests.title: Acolyte Wand
description: Priests heal and protect their friends, and are the bane of the undead.
Craft an Acolyte Wand (JEI shows the recipe). It carries Heal and adds healing power: hold it and press use (right-click) to cast.
Holy Wands and Holy Staves, made with gold, are stronger; the staves carry Holy Shock.

tasks.title: Cast a spell with a healing wand

quests.title: Holy Book
description: At the Spell Binding Table, create a Holy Book and bind your first Priest spell into it.
Equip it in its spell book slot and hold a Holy Staff or Wand, whose healing power its spells draw on. Cast one.

quests.title: Priest Robes
description: Priest robes give little armor, but each piece adds a fifth to your healing power. Craft them (JEI shows the recipe) or buy them from a Monk.
Prior robes come next, made with gold and ghast tears, and then their netherite version at the smithing table.

quests.title: A Rogue's Dagger
description: Rogues are quick: daggers and sickles, light armor, and skills that strike from the shadows.
Craft an Iron Dagger (JEI shows the recipe). It carries Fan of Knives; sickles carry Swipe. Hold it and press use (right-click) to use the skill.

quests.title: Rogue Handbook
description: At the Spell Binding Table, create a Rogue Handbook and bind your first Rogue skill into it.
Equip it in its spell book slot and hold your weapon: its skills join the weapon's on the spell bar. Use one.

quests.title: Rogue Armor
description: Rogue armor is leather that adds evasion and attack speed. Craft it (JEI shows the recipe).
Assassin armor comes next, made with rabbit hide, and then its netherite version at the smithing table.

quests.title: A Warrior's Axe
description: Warriors wear heavy armor and swing big weapons, at their best in the thick of a fight.
Craft an Iron Double Axe (JEI shows the recipe). It carries Whirlwind: hold it and press use (right-click) to use the skill.

quests.title: Warriors' Codex
description: At the Spell Binding Table, create a Warriors' Codex and bind your first Warrior skill into it.
Equip it in its spell book slot and hold your weapon: its skills join the weapon's on the spell bar. Use one.

quests.title: Warrior Armor
description: Warrior armor is iron plate that adds attack damage. Craft it (JEI shows the recipe).
Berserker armor comes next, made with chains and netherite scrap, and then its netherite version at the smithing table.
